# MCP Integration Manual Trigger

`mcp-integration.yml`'s `push` trigger is path-filtered (see `README.md` in
this directory) so it only runs when MCP-related files change. To run it on
`master` without touching real code or config, add a new dated entry below
and push to `master` — this file is itself one of the filtered paths.
